card.name: Digits inside dates and URLs
card.fires_on: Digits partway through a year or a numeric web address, and a few scattered words like 'of' or 'increase' in phrases about time span or extent. The most consistent trigger is a digit inside an AAFP-style URL or a year range.

modes.label: Digits in URLs and years
modes.description: A single digit inside a long number in a web address, a year, or a count.

modes.label: Duration-related words
modes.description: Words like 'increase' or 'of' in phrases about duration or superlatives.
